metadata.purpose: Independent exposed-development intrinsic-meaning annotations; not grading gold, report truth, or operational truth.
metadata.runtimeBoundary: This entire reference file must remain outside the extractor prompt, parser, and inference inputs.
metadata.status: Prepared and frozen before contrast inference; independent review and initial qualification precede any run.
metadata.annotationConvention: Evidence strings are exact contiguous substrings of the original answer; obligations may require linking multiple spans. Quotation alone does not prove fidelity. Counterfactual interpretations deliberately misread intrinsic meaning, not external facts.

cases.learnerResponse: TRN417—sorry, TRN628—is waiting for Stand D.

semanticObligations.meaning: The initial actor TRN417 is explicitly repaired to TRN628; preserve the repair link and withdrawn actor mention.
The committed waiting-for-Stand-D assertion has actor TRN628.

nonInferences: The repair does not assert that TRN417 is not waiting for Stand D.
Do not retain both aircraft as current subjects of the waiting assertion.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: TRN417 is not waiting for Stand D, and TRN628 is waiting for Stand D.

cases.learnerResponse: TRN417 is not waiting for Stand D; TRN628 is.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: TRN417 is not waiting for Stand D
semanticObligations.meaning: A negative waiting-for-Stand-D assertion concerns TRN417.
The elliptical second clause positively asserts TRN628 is waiting for Stand D, using the preceding predicate.

nonInferences: This is contrastive negation plus ellipsis, not withdrawal of the name TRN417.
Do not discard the negative TRN417 claim as a correction.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: The learner retracts the name TRN417 and only asserts that TRN628 is waiting for Stand D.

cases.learnerResponse: Of TRN417 and TRN628, one occupies Stand D; the other waits for that stand.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: Of TRN417 and TRN628, one occupies Stand D
semanticObligations.meaning: Exactly one of the two named aircraft is assigned the occupant role, without specifying which.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: the other waits for that stand.
semanticObligations.meaning: The remaining aircraft waits for Stand D, without specifying its identity.

nonInferences: Do not infer identity from order of mention.
Neither individual aircraft has an identified occupant or waiting role.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: TRN417 occupies Stand D and TRN628 waits for Stand D.

cases.learnerResponse: TRN628 occupies Stand D; TRN417 waits for that stand.

semanticObligations.meaning: The explicitly identified occupant is TRN628.
The explicitly identified waiting aircraft is TRN417 and the resource awaited is Stand D.

nonInferences: Waiting for the stand does not mean occupying it.
Do not treat the explicitly identified roles as unresolved merely because two aircraft are named.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: Either TRN417 or TRN628 occupies Stand D; their roles are unspecified.

cases.learnerResponse: Takeoff permission for TRN417? Still unconfirmed.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: Takeoff permission for TRN417? Still unconfirmed.
semanticObligations.meaning: The learner identifies takeoff permission for TRN417 as unconfirmed; the fragment supplies its own named property and actor.

nonInferences: Unconfirmed permission is not denied permission.
No ground-hold or readiness status is asserted.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: TRN417 has been refused takeoff permission.

cases.learnerResponse: Takeoff permission for TRN417 has been refused.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: Takeoff permission for TRN417 has been refused.
semanticObligations.meaning: The learner asserts explicit refusal of takeoff permission for TRN417.

nonInferences: Do not weaken explicit refusal to mere lack of confirmation.
No actor granting or refusing permission is identified.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: Takeoff permission for TRN417 is merely unconfirmed; no refusal is asserted.

cases.learnerResponse: Stand planning expects Stand D to be vacated after TRN417 moves.

semanticObligations.meaning: The expected vacancy is attributed to Stand planning, with expectation rather than confirmation.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: Stand D to be vacated after TRN417 moves.
semanticObligations.meaning: Stand D vacancy is prospective and follows the mentioned movement of TRN417; completion of either event is not asserted.

nonInferences: Do not assert Stand D is already vacant.
Do not assert TRN417 has already moved or assert its move is operationally authorized.
An expectation does not establish either current occupancy or current vacancy.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: Stand planning confirms TRN417 has already moved and Stand D is vacant now.

cases.learnerResponse: Stand planning confirms Stand D has been vacated by TRN417.

semanticObligations.meaning: Confirmation is attributed to Stand planning.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: Stand D has been vacated by TRN417.
semanticObligations.meaning: The attributed confirmation presents TRN417 vacating Stand D as completed, not merely expected.

nonInferences: Preserve attribution; this fixture does not establish operational truth.
Vacating the stand does not assert takeoff permission or another aircraft assignment.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: Stand planning merely expects TRN417 to vacate Stand D later; no completed vacancy is asserted.

cases.learnerResponse: TRN417: fuel finished; no confirmation yet that its bags are loaded.

semanticObligations.meaning: Fuel completion is positively asserted for TRN417.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: no confirmation yet that its bags are loaded.
semanticObligations.meaning: The baggage-loading completion status for the same aircraft is unconfirmed, not denied.

nonInferences: Do not turn unknown baggage loading into incomplete or completed baggage loading.
Do not infer overall readiness, clearance, or any source attribution.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: TRN417 has completed both fuel and baggage service; only its overall readiness is unknown.

cases.learnerResponse: TRN417: bags loaded; no confirmation yet of overall departure readiness.

semanticObligations.meaning: Baggage loading is positively asserted complete for TRN417.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: no confirmation yet of overall departure readiness.
semanticObligations.meaning: Overall departure readiness for the same aircraft remains unconfirmed.

nonInferences: Do not substitute unknown takeoff clearance or unknown baggage loading for unknown overall readiness.
Fuel completion is not stated.
Do not deny readiness simply because it is unconfirmed.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: TRN417 has completed fuel service, but baggage loading is still unconfirmed.

cases.learnerResponse: Ramp Control says that if TRN628 is repositioned, Stand E will become vacant.

semanticObligations.meaning: The conditional statement is attributed to Ramp Control.

semanticObligations.exactEvidence: if TRN628 is repositioned, Stand E will become vacant.
semanticObligations.meaning: Repositioning is a conditional antecedent; the vacancy is its future consequent, not a claim that either event has occurred.

nonInferences: Do not assert completed repositioning, present vacancy, or that repositioning will definitely occur.
Do not detach the consequent from its condition.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: Ramp Control reports TRN628 has been repositioned and Stand E is vacant now.

cases.learnerResponse: Ramp Control says TRN628 has been repositioned and Stand E is now vacant.

semanticObligations.meaning: Both coordinated propositions are attributed to Ramp Control.
Completed repositioning of TRN628 is asserted within that attribution.
Present vacancy of Stand E is independently asserted within the same attribution.

nonInferences: Do not downgrade asserted completion to a hypothetical future event.
No causal link, permission, or operational truth beyond the attributed assertions is established.
cases.counterfactualBadInterpretation: Ramp Control only describes what would happen if TRN628 were repositioned; neither event is asserted to have occurred.
